original_tasks.title: Project skeleton, errors, item model and add
original_tasks.description: Create package `todo` with errors.py (TodoError, ItemNotFoundError, ValidationError), an Item dataclass, TodoStore with internal dict storage and id counter, add(title), and a shared internal helper to look up an item by id with validation (non-int/bool -> ValidationError, unknown -> ItemNotFoundError with id in message). Add tests/test_add.py and a test of the id lookup helper behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: add returns item with id 1, stripped title, completed False, due_date None, priority 'medium'
second add gets id 2; id not reused after internal removal
add('') , add('   ') and add(123) raise ValidationError
lookup helper raises ItemNotFoundError mentioning the id for unknown ids and ValidationError for non-int/bool ids
tests/test_add.py passes

original_tasks.title: List items
original_tasks.description: Implement list_items() returning a new list of items in id order.
acceptance_criteria: empty store returns []
returns items in insertion order
mutating the returned list does not change the store
tests/test_list.py passes

original_tasks.title: Mark item complete
original_tasks.description: Implement complete(item_id) using the lookup helper.
acceptance_criteria: complete sets completed True and returns the item
completing twice keeps it True with no error
unknown id raises ItemNotFoundError; non-int id raises ValidationError
tests/test_complete.py passes

original_tasks.title: Delete item
acceptance_criteria: deleted item not in list_items
deleting again raises ItemNotFoundError
unknown id raises ItemNotFoundError
new add after delete gets a fresh id
tests/test_delete.py passes

original_tasks.title: Rename item
original_tasks.description: Implement rename(item_id, new_title) with title validation shared with add.
acceptance_criteria: rename updates and strips the title and returns the item
empty, whitespace-only and non-str titles raise ValidationError and leave title unchanged
unknown id raises ItemNotFoundError
tests/test_rename.py passes

original_tasks.title: Set due date
original_tasks.description: Implement set_due_date(item_id, due) accepting date, ISO string, or None.
acceptance_criteria: date object stored as-is; ISO string parsed to date
None clears the due date
'2024-13-45', 'tomorrow', 123 raise ValidationError and leave value unchanged
unknown id raises ItemNotFoundError
tests/test_due_date.py passes

original_tasks.title: Set priority
acceptance_criteria: each of the three valid values is stored and the item returned
'urgent', '', None, 'HIGH' raise ValidationError and leave priority unchanged
unknown id raises ItemNotFoundError
tests/test_priority.py passes

original_tasks.title: Filter by status
acceptance_criteria: 'open' returns only incomplete items in id order
'complete' returns only completed items in id order
invalid status (e.g. 'done', None, '') raises ValidationError
tests/test_filter.py passes

original_tasks.title: Search by text
original_tasks.description: Implement search(text) as a case-insensitive substring match on title.
acceptance_criteria: matches case-insensitively and returns in id order
no match returns []
empty, whitespace-only or non-str query raises ValidationError
tests/test_search.py passes

original_tasks.title: Export to JSON
original_tasks.description: Implement export_json() returning a JSON string list of item dicts with keys id, title, completed, due_date (ISO or null), priority.
acceptance_criteria: empty store returns '[]'
output parses with json.loads to list of dicts with exactly the five keys
due_date serialised as ISO string or null; completed as JSON bool
tests/test_export.py passes

original_tasks.title: Import from JSON
original_tasks.description: Implement import_json(json_str) with full validation, atomic replacement of existing items, and id counter set past the highest imported id. Reuse existing validators for title, priority and due date.
acceptance_criteria: round trip export_json -> import_json into a new store reproduces identical items and returns the count
import replaces existing items; next add id is max imported id + 1
malformed JSON, non-list top level, missing keys, wrong types, empty title, bad priority, bad due_date, non-bool completed, non-int/bool id and duplicate ids all raise ValidationError
after a failed import the store's previous items and id counter are unchanged
tests/test_import.py passes
